scripts.build: npm run build --workspace src/web && npm run build --workspace src/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace src/server && npm run typecheck --workspace src/web
scripts.test: npm test --workspace src/server && npm test --workspace src/web && npm run test:e2e-env
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace src/server" "npm run dev --workspace src/web"
